description: This bar chart, from the paper "Text Generation with Diffusion Language Models: A Pre-training Approach with Continuous Paragraph Denoise," illustrates the performance of two metrics, ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2, across five different diffusion steps (100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000). The horizontal axis, labeled "Diffusion Step," represents the discrete steps at which performance was measured, while the vertical axis represents the metric scores, though its label and scale are not explicitly shown. For each diffusion step, two bars are presented side-by-side: a blue bar with diagonal stripes representing ROUGE-1 and an orange bar with a dotted pattern representing ROUGE-2. The chart displays the following values: at step 100, ROUGE-1 is 6.3 and ROUGE-2 is 3.0; at step 250, ROUGE-1 is 11.6 and ROUGE-2 is 8.3; at step 500, ROUGE-1 is 21.1 and ROUGE-2 is 15.9; at step 1000, ROUGE-1 is 38.3 and ROUGE-2 is 30.7; and at step 2000, ROUGE-1 is 41.2 and ROUGE-2 is 33.4. The bars are grouped by diffusion step and are not sorted, with the tallest bars appearing at the rightmost position. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that identifies the blue striped bar as ROUGE-1 and the orange dotted bar as ROUGE-2. There are no visual annotations or emphasis on specific bars beyond the numerical labels atop each bar.
